name: duopore-public-expense-category-summary
description: See where money went by grouping your expenses and refunds for a date range.

interface.longDescription: See where money went by grouping your expenses and refunds for a date range. Share dated amounts and the categories you choose. Get totals and shares for each category, with refunds included. Use one currency for the list. The app does not connect to a bank or decide which costs can be claimed for tax.
defaultPrompt: Group these expenses by category for this month.
Show spending and refunds within these dates.

positive.prompt: Use Expense Category Summary with these explicitly supplied fictional inputs. Return the worksheet and limitations for my review: {"fromDate":"2026-10-01","toDate":"2026-10-31","expenses":[{"expenseId":"01","date":"2026-10-02","category":"Software","amount":100},{"expenseId":"02","date":"2026-10-03","category":"Software","amount":-20},{"expenseId":"03","date":"2026-10-04","category":"Travel","amount":40}]}
positive.expected_behavior: Use only these supplied inputs; no external verification, saving, sending or invented facts. Expected structured result: {"summary":"2 categories total 120.00; 0 entries outside the date range.","rows":[{"category":"Software","entries":2,"netAmount":80,"shareOfNetPercent":66.67},{"category":"Travel","entries":1,"netAmount":40,"shareOfNetPercent":33.33}],"warnings":["User-assigned categories and one currency only; no tax classification.","Refunds may create negative or greater-than-100% net shares; zero net total has no defined share."]}
